notes: The crew plugin's overlay for mypaisa-agent (MA-361). It holds no rules of its own: it points at this repo's rules and gates. Check it with /crew:init --check.
The commands for the fast checks (ruff, pyright, lint-imports, pytest on the tests touched) are in backend/CLAUDE.md and scripts/backend_gates.sh.
The commands for the fast checks (svelte-check, eslint, prettier, vitest on the tests touched) are in web/CLAUDE.md and scripts/web_gates.sh.
web/src/lib/styles/tokens.css and motion.css are held equal to docs/design/ds-v1/ by a test: a design-system change reaches both in one lane.
The iOS app is run and shown from Xcode itself, never Claude's simulator tool or panel (Arun).
Colours are generated by scripts/ios_tokens.py, never edited by hand.
The data model is ARCHITECTURE.md sections 4.1 and 4.8: one DynamoDB table, mypaisa-<env>-core.
The table's definition is in infra/modules/mypaisa/main.tf and belongs to the infra area. Locally, moto makes the table in scripts/local/aws.py.
Terraform runs only through infra/scripts/tf.sh <root> plan -out=<file>.tfplan, then show. The wrapper refuses a local prod apply and refuses destroy.
A merge waits for every check, CodeQL's included (MA-346). Prod is deployed only by release.yml, after Arun approves in the GitHub prod environment.
Boards are drawn in the repo as .dc.html files on MyPaisa DS v1. The lead publishes each round as a private Artifact and brings back Arun's pick.
docs/design/prototype-v5/ is a record and is never updated (MA-301).

Generated, never edited by hand: docs/TRACE.md (python3 scripts/plan_sync.py render), docs/confluence/** (python3 scripts/confluence_docs.py write), PLAN.md's Timeline table (python3 scripts/roadmap.py write).
Publishing to Confluence and writing to Jira are the lead's acts, through /plan-sync (on Arun's yes) and /jira-flow:track.
A gate fails closed and its selftest proves it bites (lessons 12, 16 and 49 of .claude/rules/independent-review.md).
.claude/settings.json and .claude/hooks/ are the lead's to change, not a worker's.

flows.plan: /jira-flow:plan for new work, with its PLAN.md bullet, its docs/trace.json row, its estimate in docs/roadmap.json and its Confluence page in the same change (.claude/rules/plan-sync.md, New work)
flows.start: Ask first, in one question before the first edit: /plan-sync MA-<n>, then python3 scripts/plan_sync.py start MA-<n>; move the issue to In Progress at the first edit (.claude/rules/jira-flow.md, habit 2)
flows.design: /design-first: options drawn as boards in the repo, the round shown as a private Artifact, and only the option Arun picks is built
flows.track: /jira-flow:track before a change is reported as done
flows.ship: /autoship: the story's other gates, commit, push, then the one question (plan-sync, the security scan, the PR, QA and the review where they apply, the merge); on the yes, sync, scan, raise the PR, wait for every check (.claude/rules/ship-autopilot.md)
flows.review: Only on Arun's yes, one yes per round: gates first, then crew:reviewer lanes a, b, c, d and f in one message, briefed from .claude/skills/autoship/review-brief.md; the ledger is review/MA-<n>/ (.claude/rules/independent-review.md)
flows.qa: Only on Arun's word (.claude/rules/crew.md). The checklist is docs/qa/checklist.md; the web app's QA tooling is MA-304

shared.why: one writer; plan-sync checks it after every edit
estimates move the schedule and PLAN.md's Timeline
only the coordinator records a publish (MA-301)
regenerated from the API; the web lane then regenerates its types with pnpm api:types
one lane changes Python dependencies at a time
one lockfile for the web and iOS workspace; one lane changes it at a time
a change reaches web/src/lib/styles and, through scripts/ios_tokens.py, the iOS colours

limits: Every branch, commit and PR carries its MA-<n> key; the lead commits, at the join (.claude/rules/jira-flow.md).
AWS is changed by Terraform only, in infra/; reads go through the AWS MCP; prod is never applied from the laptop; nobody reads a secret value (.claude/rules/aws-changes.md).
Anything that costs money in AWS is asked first, with the price (.claude/rules/aws-changes.md).
A story with UI is built only from a board Arun picked; if the build has to differ, the board changes first (.claude/rules/plan-sync.md, rules 2 to 4).
A design change goes to docs/design/ios-v1, app-v1 and ds-v1 only; Prototype v5 is never updated (.claude/rules/plan-sync.md, rule 5).
Confluence pages are generated here and published by /plan-sync, never edited by hand (.claude/rules/plan-sync.md, rule 8).
Every file a story changes under backend/, web/, ios/ or infra/ is claimed by that story's code paths in docs/trace.json (python3 scripts/plan_sync.py pr-files).

Plan-sync and the security scan run only on Arun's yes, asked once at the end of the work (.claude/rules/ship-autopilot.md, "Plan-sync and the security scan ask first"). The generators (roadmap.py write, plan_sync.py render, confluence_docs.py write), the hooks and CI still run as configured.
No review, QA or other checking agent runs unasked: it is offered in the merge question, and each review round needs its own yes (.claude/rules/ship-autopilot.md, .claude/rules/crew.md).
No em dashes in Jira text or in AWS names, tags and descriptions (.claude/rules/jira-flow.md, .claude/rules/aws-changes.md).

ask.end: MA-<n> is ready: PR #<n> `[MA-<n>] ...`, checks green (<the checks>). Run QA on <what changed> first, review it first (lanes: <the lanes with changes>; one round, each later round asked first), then merge, or merge it into main now? (MA-<n> goes to Done after the merge.)
